# SI031 — nondet-in-loop-unbounded

Non-deterministic calls must not run in an unbounded loop.

## Why

An unbounded loop lets a caller multiply LLM calls and cause timeouts or unpredictable cost.

## Bad

```python
while True:
    gl.nondet.exec_prompt(prompt)
```

## Good

```python
for clause_id in policy.clause_ids:
    ...  # capped at deploy time
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI031 -- reason
```
